arguments.code:
import re, json
data=json.load(open('input.json'))
pat=r'[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{3}(-R)?'
for e in data['examples']:
    m=bool(re.fullmatch(pat,e['text']))
    print(e['text'], m, e['matches'], 'OK' if m==e['matches'] else 'BAD')
